title: Kicked Spicy Thai Chicken Curry
description: A rich and spicy Thai curry made with dried chillies and coconut cream, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this dish is ayurvedic tamasic friendly and cooked to perfection on a salt block.
instructions: Preheat the salt block over medium high heat for 10 minutes.
Grind the dried red chillies into a fine powder using a spice grinder.
Heat the oil on the preheated salt block and add the minced garlic and bruised lemon grass.
Add the chicken to the salt block and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the ground chillies, fish sauce, and lime juice to the salt block and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut cream and stir to combine, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium low and let the curry simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
